description.value: Epic Grill Silogs is a small restaurant serving Chinese and Filipino cuisine, including the Filipino staple silog dishes (garlic rice with protein). It operates as a takeout-friendly spot and maintains a no-smoking environment. Touring cyclists passing through the New Westminster area may find it a quick stop for hearty, inexpensive Filipino comfort food.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website epicsilogsgrill.com has been taken over by a domain parking service (ParkLogic.com) and contains no content related to the restaurant; all subpages redirect to generic category searches or show malware warnings, so the website cannot be used as an evidence source. All amenity answers beyond OSM tags are therefore null. OSM confirms takeaway=yes and smoking=no, but the community field says Richmond while postcode V3M 5B8 is actually New Westminster — a discrepancy flagged in the url_discovery_notes as well.
concerns: Website epicsilogsgrill.com is a parked/squatted domain (ParkLogic.com) with no restaurant content — the original site appears abandoned, which may signal the business has closed.
Address postcode V3M 5B8 is New Westminster, but OSM and the _community field both say Richmond — incorrect community attribution.
The /about-us.php subpage redirected to a potentially malicious domain (onlineresultsfinder.com), flagged by security software.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The registered domain epicsilogsgrill.com has been parked by ParkLogic.com and contains no restaurant content, suggesting the business may have closed or abandoned its web presence; the business cannot be independently verified as currently operating.
enrichment_extras.notes: Cuisine tagged as Chinese and Filipino in OSM; the name 'Silogs' is a specifically Filipino dish category, suggesting Filipino food is the primary offering.
